delegate_commands: ocr delegate rule --format json apps/web/src/components/intake i18n/en-US.json

findings.problem: The component tracks delivery order with a counter that is reassigned inside the render callback, so React Compiler refuses to optimize the component and `vp check` reports an immutability error.
findings.why: The phase gate runs lint; a repo-wide gate would fail on this file.
findings.fix: Precompute a Map<id, ordinal> with a plain for loop before returning, and read from it inside the map.

findings.problem: An unmapped status_changed without a note returned null, so a future transition would silently disappear from the guest timeline.
findings.why: The activity timeline is the guest's only record of the request; dropping an entry is worse than a generic label.
findings.fix: Fall back to the existing `intake:detail.status_changed` label instead of null.

findings.problem: The loading state did not reserve a line for the stepper, although the approved ui-spec lists a one-line stepper skeleton to avoid layout shift.
findings.why: The detail jumps by roughly one block when the request lands.
findings.fix: Added one `h-4 w-1/2` skeleton between title and body.

findings.problem: The rejected branch always marks Submitted and Received as done, even when a request is rejected directly from `new` (before triage).
findings.why: The prototype and ui-spec prescribe exactly this three-step branch, but the detail response carries only the current status, so the UI cannot know where the rejection happened.
findings.fix: Kept as designed (ui-spec v14, prototype stepStates). Changing it needs an approved design change; the activity timeline still shows the true transition.

findings.problem: `task_linked` is now filtered out for staff as well, because the list component is shared. Requirement §9 allows only the optional-note dialog as a staff change.
findings.why: Staff lose one activity line about linking a task, although the linked-tasks section still lists every linked task.
findings.fix: Kept because the P3 plan says to hide `task_linked` and the guest API already filters it; listed here so the gate can decide. Adding a guest-only prop is the alternative.

findings.problem: The shared detail now reads the session to map activity actors, so both guest and staff detail mount `authClient.useSession()`.
findings.why: One extra session read per detail; better-auth serves it from its store, and no request data crosses the boundary.
findings.fix: Accepted: the actor cannot be derived from the intake response (it holds only `createdById`), and this is the same hook other web components use.

findings.problem: The guest dialog keys are still named `revisionTitle`/`revisionDescription` while the copy is now "Need feedback"; `i18n/schema.json` was stale after adding keys.
findings.why: Names no longer match the vocabulary the product uses.
findings.fix: Kept the key names to avoid churn across 20 locales (values changed only), and regenerated `i18n/schema.json` with `pnpm i18n:schema`.

findings.problem: The staff dialog invites a reply on every delivery, but the activity only rendered the note for the second and later deliveries; a first-delivery note was stored and never shown to the guest.
findings.why: The guest could not read a reply the UI explicitly asked staff to write (AC-17).
findings.fix: `delivered` with a note now uses `intake:activity.deliveredWithNote` (`…for your review: {{note}}`).
findings.source: round 2 (user asked for open code review)

findings.problem: The deliver note is optional, so a repeat delivery without a note rendered `"Team delivered this request again: "` with a dangling colon.
findings.why: Copy bug visible in the guest timeline whenever staff re-delivered without a reply.
findings.fix: Added `intake:activity.deliveredAgainNoNote`; the code now picks the copy from the note.
findings.source: round 2 (user asked for open code review)

findings.problem: Types without a copy key (`revision_requested`, `note_added`) fall back to `intake:detail.<type>` and would render the raw key.
findings.why: The API never writes those types today, so it cannot happen yet.
findings.fix: Left as-is; pre-existing, recorded for a later cleanup.
